# uiik

> A UI interactions kit — draggable, droppable, resizable, rotatable, splittable, selectable, sortable — plus the geometry and measurement utilities they are built on. One set of options and one set of CSS hooks for both HTML and SVG.

uiik is a framework-agnostic TypeScript/JavaScript library for adding direct-manipulation
interactions to DOM elements. Every interaction is created through a `newXxx(els, opts)`
factory, and every option is optional. Each source module is also published as a subpath
(`uiik/draggable`, `uiik/geometry`, …) so callers can import only what they need.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): overview, quick start, full option list, subpath export table, CSS hooks
- [API reference (hosted)](https://holyhigh2.github.io/uiik/): rendered TSDoc for every export
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): release history, breaking changes
- [README (中文)](README_ZH.md): Chinese translation of the overview

## Interactions

- [draggable.ts](src/draggable.ts): `newDraggable` — dragging with containment, ghost, group, snap, grid, auto-scroll
- [droppable.ts](src/droppable.ts): `newDroppable` — drop targets for draggables
- [resizable.ts](src/resizable.ts): `newResizable` — 8-direction resize handles with constraints
- [rotatable.ts](src/rotatable.ts): `newRotatable` — rotation handle around a pivot
- [splittable.ts](src/splittable.ts): `newSplittable` — horizontal/vertical split panes
- [selectable.ts](src/selectable.ts): `newSelectable` — marquee/rubber-band selection
- [sortable.ts](src/sortable.ts): `newSortable` — reorderable lists and grids
- [detector.ts](src/detector.ts): `newCollisionDetector` — collision detection between rects

## Utilities

- [geometry.ts](src/geometry.ts): `alignRects` `distributeRects` `snapGuides` `findSnap` `snapToGrid` `resizeRect` `fitRectInViewport` `zoomAt` `panBy`
- [transform.ts](src/transform.ts): `wrapper` returns a `UiiTransform` that hides HTML/SVG transform differences — `moveTo` `moveBy` `rotateTo` `getTranslate`
- [utils.ts](src/utils.ts): measurement helpers — `getRectInContainer` `getVertex` `getMatrixInfo` `getScrollParent` `isVisible`
- [types.ts](src/types.ts): `Uii` base class, `UII_KEY`, all option interfaces
- [index.ts](src/index.ts): root entry — re-exports everything, plus a `default` export and `VERSION`

## Development

- [package.json](package.json): scripts, entry points, `files` publish whitelist
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): build/test/convention instructions for AI coding agents
- [.agents/skills](.agents/skills): repo-scoped skills (build-verification, unit tests)
- [vite.config.mjs](vite.config.mjs) and [vite.config.esm.mjs](vite.config.esm.mjs): UMD + per-module ESM build
- [spec](spec): `node:test` suite running against a jsdom global
